body:
Founder direction: combat's hit/miss and crit RNG should reuse this monorepo's own standing weighted-marble-bag+Fibonacci-pity pull algorithm rather than independent rolls, citing the existing design note naming this as a shared-utility opportunity across ECOWAR card draw/pack-opening and Prompt-o-verse discovery. New server/rng package (Fibonacci, MarbleBagPick), a faithful Go port of ECOWAR's arena_fibonacci/arena_marble_bag_pick. Found and documented a real pre-existing off-by-one in ECOWAR's own header comment (claims fib(10)=55, real code computes 89) via my own test suite -- port matches the real algorithm, not the wrong comment. 7 new tests including a real drought-shifts-the-odds structural check. JOB_SPELL_SYSTEM_NORTHSTAR.md updated with the real design for wiring this into hit/miss and crit/normal (2-outcome bags each), damage magnitude staying a plain uniform roll since marble-bag+pity is for discrete outcomes only. Commit c4ea45e.

⚓ ☃
title: Combat RNG: shared marble-bag + Fibonacci pity utility (server/rng)
